name: Bodhtree Consulting Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1998, Bodhtree 
Consulting Ltd is an IT and IT 
enabling services provider[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
BTCL is an ISO 9001:2008, ISO 27001:2005, and CMMI Level 5 certified IT & product engineering services provider. It helps enterprises transform operations using cloud, analytics, and digital technologies by deploying enterprise applications, integrating them with existing IT infrastructure, and providing ongoing maintenance & support.

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -46.7% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -30.8% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.36 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 366 days.
Working capital days have increased from 218 days to 387 days
